scientific_question: Under the 124M constant-full-carry mechanism that is useful in real training, does the previously validated hidden64+48 c_proj spatial chart track the complete dense trajectory materially better than the production hidden64+24 chart?

evidence_before_registration.interpretation: The prior held-out one-step screen supports extra hidden/right directions, but the temporal error-feedback mechanism changes the effective requested update. A full-trajectory causal replay is required before production promotion.

teacher_forcing_protocol.trajectory_reset: Each arm/layer starts once from the exact dense step-0 c_proj weight and follows all 238 updates without phase reset.
teacher_forcing_protocol.per_step_target: Use recorded dense W[t+1]-W[t], remove dense decoupled weight decay before matching, add the arm's prior compression residual with decay 1.0, then apply registered weight decay once.
teacher_forcing_protocol.causality: At step t an arm sees only its current weight, current recorded dense update, and its own prior compression residual.
teacher_forcing_protocol.fit: First fit 64 deterministic hidden/right stages. Fit the second pass to the remaining current corrected-update residual using either 24 or 48 deterministic stages with the same seed family.
teacher_forcing_protocol.interpretation: This optimistic zero-update replay tests spatial transport capacity under full carry; it does not measure language-model loss.

metrics.aggregate: Energy-weight endpoint and row-Gram recovery across five layers; report minimum layer recovery, maximum feedback norm, and per-layer wins.

registered_decision_rule.candidate_pass: All metrics must be finite. Hidden112 endpoint recovery must be no worse than hidden88 at every score step, at least 1.05x hidden88 at step 238, and better in at least 4/5 terminal layers. Its terminal maximum feedback norm must be at most 0.95x hidden88, and its terminal aggregate row-Gram recovery and mean requested-update recovery must each be no worse than hidden88.
registered_decision_rule.selection: Select hidden112 only if every rule passes; otherwise retain hidden88 and close this extra-stage branch.
registered_decision_rule.authorization_on_pass: Implement only hidden64+48 for c_proj constant-full-carry, add production/config tests, then separately preregister and directly poll an exact 124M >=20% MFU gate. No language-model training is authorized by this plan.
registered_decision_rule.authorization_on_failure: Do not implement or train hidden112. Move to the preregistered-by-evidence dimensionless residual-norm-cap family rather than another time schedule.
